purpose: Preserve weak physically-authored normal and metallic/smoothness signals for apartment-detail materials until they can be judged from native 3840x2160 Unity evidence. Block compression is not accepted for these physical-data maps because it can quantize tangent-space direction, roughness width and metallic response before grazing-light review.

scope.albedoPolicy: Not part of this lossless gate. This change protects high-frequency physical response without imposing unnecessary memory cost on lower-frequency colour data.

physicalInterpretation.wetness: dry benchmark unless another cause-based weather state is explicitly authored and separately verified
physicalInterpretation.angularResponse: Unity Standard physically based response; Fresnel/specular response must arise from material state and lighting, never from painted highlights

profileNotes.MAT_AgedAluminum: anodized/extruded aluminium directional grain; metallic source remains bounded by the existing microstructure profile
profileNotes.MAT_DarkGalvanizedSteel: galvanized steel zinc-spangle-like microvariation without glitter or baked light direction
profileNotes.MAT_WindowRubber: EPDM-like dielectric rubber microrelief; metallic remains zero
profileNotes.MAT_AgedACPlastic: aged ABS-like dielectric orange-peel microrelief; UV aging belongs in colour/aging policy rather than fake specular paint
profileNotes.MAT_PipeInsulation: dielectric wrap/foam skin with shallow wrap cadence
profileNotes.MAT_DrainHose: dielectric polymer hose with circumferential corrugation signal

requiredRenderedEvidence: 3840x2160 oblique case showing representative apartment-detail materials
3840x2160 grazing-light case where normal and roughness response are visible
100% detail-material crop from the native 4K frame
100% construction-interface crop where the material meets its mounting context
subpixel/grazing temporal evidence for sparkle, shimmer and mip stability

failureInjection: Set any protected texture to CompressedHQ or another compressed mode and require formal pre-cull failure.
Enable Crunch compression and require failure.
Enable a Standalone platform texture override and require failure.
Set maxTextureSize below 1024 and require failure.
Set filter mode to Bilinear or Point and require failure.
Set anisotropy below 8 and require failure.
Enable sRGB on a protected physical-data texture and require failure.
Change a MicroNormal importer away from NormalMap and require failure.
Change a MetallicSmoothness importer away from Default or stop preserving input alpha and require failure.
